LOOK OUT FOR THAT WAVE OF IDEAS.  
On 25 September 2026 the Sun faces Neptune in a close, applying opposition. Symbolically, the bright center of your day (the Sun) is nudging the dreamy, elusive Neptune—so clarity meets imagination. This tension can stir creative impulses or, if left unchecked, muddle decisions. Ground your ideas by jotting a quick sketch or setting a small, tangible goal. Let the mystery inspire, but anchor it with a concrete action you can finish today.  

Write down one creative goal by noon.
